title: Bug CRUD API and UI
description: Implement the Bug entity with full CRUD: REST API routes with flat JSON persistence, frontend API service, list view with clickable cards, detail view with edit/delete, and create/edit form with validation. Generate seed data for demo.
designContext: Bug entity with fields: title (required string), description (string), status (enum: open/in-progress/resolved/closed, default open), priority (enum: critical/high/medium/low, default medium), assignee (string). Flat JSON file persistence in data/bugs.json. REST API at /api/v1/bugs. Frontend components: bug-card, bug-form, bug-detail. Seed 12 realistic bugs.
